production.direction_en: A round archive is carved into the stairwell. Aveline, Mirel, Clem, Pippa and Kera rebuild the erased record from copied names, bell rubbings and Jori's forge marks.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ledger_motif under the voices reading names | post: bgm_fadyme_theme with choir when the name is written back; this is the emotional peak before the boss

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Give me the pen. My hand helped erase it. This time, my hand writes it back.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Fadyme Veyr. The record accepts the ink.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: My mother's name. It was hers before it was mine.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: I am sorry. I wanted one more quiet day before you knew even this much.
